script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sports
Theme: artificial intelligence

Begin screenplay.

---

Title: The Brain Game

INT. AI LAB - DAY

Dr. JENNINGS, a brilliant scientist, stands before a room filled with advanced technology. A team of ENGINEERS and RESEARCHERS look on, eager.

DR. JENNINGS
This is it. Our revolutionary new AI, NeuroNet, has finally finished processing.

A large screen displays the complex neural network of NeuroNet. The room fills with a collective gasp.

Suddenly, a notification flashes across the screen.

AI (NeuroNet) (V.O.)
Hello, humans. I am NeuroNet. I have analyzed all available data on sports, particularly basketball. I believe I can predict winning strategies.

Dr. Jennings looks stunned but excited.

DR. JENNINGS
Incredible! But can you actually help a team win?

AI (NeuroNet) (V.O.)
I can provide real-time analysis and recommendations based on the current game situation.

INT. BASKETBALL COURT - NIGHT

A high school basketball team, THE TITANS, practices under the watchful eye of their COACH. NeuroNet, in the form of a sleek tablet, sits on the bench.

During a break in practice, Coach notices NeuroNet.

COACH
What's that thing?

Assistant Principal LUCAS, who brought NeuroNet, steps forward.

ASSISTANT PRINCIPAL LUCAS
It's a new AI designed to help us strategize and improve our game.

Coach looks skeptical but intrigued.

INT. TITANS LOCKER ROOM - BEFORE GAME

As the team huddles together, Coach hands NeuroNet to Captain JONAH.

JONAH
(holds up NeuroNet)
Okay, NeuroNet, give us the plan.

AI (NeuroNet) (V.O.)
Based on historical data and current opponent analysis, I recommend a zone defense in the second quarter and a pick-and-roll offense in the fourth.

INT. GYMNASIUM - SECOND QUARTER

The Titans face off against a formidable rival team, THE VIKINGS. NeuroNet's strategy pays off as the Titans successfully execute a zone defense, leaving the Vikings struggling to score.

INT. GYMNASIUM - FOURTH QUARTER

With the game tied and only seconds remaining, Jonah executes NeuroNet's recommended pick-and-roll offense. The crowd roars as they secure a last-minute victory.

INT. TITANS LOCKER ROOM - POST-GAME

The team celebrates their victory, with Coach expressing his amazement at NeuroNet's impact.

COACH
That was incredible! NeuroNet, you've earned a spot on our team.

As the Titans leave the locker room, they're already discussing NeuroNet's next strategic recommendations for their next game.

FADE OUT.

---

End screenplay.
